objective: Measure SlimInfer direction under the completed HYPIC reproduction ruler without pooling HYPIC results.

arms.baseline: same pinned service with MST_SLIMINFER_ENABLE unset

fail_fast_order: NPU eager single-request correctness and activation
independent artifact audit and resource release
activation_gate: all TP4 ranks agreed on selection digest
disabled control emitted none of the treatment events

decision_rules.performance: Report every run, mean and dispersion. A quick screen may stop an unpromising route, but is not a formal gain claim.
decision_rules.quality: Compare treatment deltas with the completed same-ruler baseline repeat variability only if all other identities remain equal; otherwise collect a fresh paired baseline.
decision_rules.algorithm_identity: Separate faithful-port, no-offload ablation, async-cache treatment and any derivative into distinct ledgers.

historical_hypic_context_only.statement: Do not reuse these as SlimInfer results.
